plans.text: Establish a consistent morning routine on weekends.
Incorporate yoga or stretching on Sunday mornings to loosen up after a week of sitting at a desk.
Read "The Lean Startup" for 30 minutes each night before bed, starting now.
Go for a 30-minute jog on Saturday morning.
Have a cup of coffee before the Saturday morning jog.
Check online for water fountains or drinking water stations along the jogging route.
Leave earbuds behind during the jog and focus on the surroundings.

superseded_plans.text: Exercise on Sunday mornings without having to wake up too early.
Try to read more before bed each night.
Go for a jog on Saturday morning.

preferences.text: Likes sleeping in a bit later on weekends.
Likes the idea of doing yoga or stretching.
Likes starting small and scaling up as they become more comfortable with a practice.
Interested in building and launching successful startups and learning about the framework in "The Lean Startup" by Eric Ries.
Prefers jogging routes that are relatively flat and have some shade.
